row: I am Doctor Arshad ( Doctor of Veterinary Medicine / DVM ) It's my Aim to Teach New Poultry Farmers about Poultry Farm Management, Diseases Prevention, Vaccinations, Fertile Eggs Handling, Hatchability, House Preparation, Brooding, Developing, Rearing, Laying, Molting, Maximum Eggs Production, Minimum Use of Antibiotics & Sound Management along with All Poultry Sectors. It's my 11th Year in Poultry Layer Breeder Farm Management, Feed Mill, Laboratory, Farms & Hatchery. I will Appreciate your Participation.
